instantiated_cells.justification: Section 13.69 sets forfeitures for principals and lobbyists who violate §§ 13.61-13.68, provides criminal penalties for falsified filings, and penalizes acting as a lobbyist without being licensed, establishing statutory penalties for lobbying-disclosure violations.

Section 13.74 requires the board to examine all required lobbying statements and authorizes investigative document review/subpoenas, which is a compliance review regime rather than a mandated regular independent third-party audit.
